title: Dependency scheduler and isolated workspace lifecycle
objective: Schedule ready tasks using hard dependency DAG and dynamic concurrency; use verified native workspace isolation or Orchestrator-owned Git Worktrees.
acceptance_criteria: Main-only, sequential, and optional parallel modes choose the simplest safe execution.
Concurrency never exceeds configured/runtime limits and decreases for resource, dependency, or file overlap risk.
Unknown native isolation is unsupported; fallback Worktrees are distinct and Orchestrator-owned.
undo_classification: Preserve unknown/uncommitted workspace changes; remove only verified node-owned temporary worktrees.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; halt cleanup on ownership uncertainty.
